svg.title: An org chart drawn from manager links — SoftTrack web design mockup (#254)
svg.desc: The manager links already hold the organisation’s shape, and it can only be read one person at a time. A chart beside the directory draws a tree from the links, with branches that open and close, search that centres on a person, a view by department, a list alternative, and a deactivated manager who still has reports marked.
svg.text: An org chart drawn from manager links
· the whole picture, where it was one profile at a time
The organisation’s shape, on the screen
A list, for keyboards and screen readers
A department can have a head

g.text: Departments were flat on purpose: heads were left out as
something that “can come later if they earn it”. The chart is where

svg.text: Done when /people/chart draws a tree from manager links for anyone who can see the directory, branches collapse and expand and a card links to the profile, search centres the
chart on a person and opens the path to them, people with no manager are roots, a deactivated manager with reports is marked, a department can have a head, the same content
is available as nested lists, and the chart exports as SVG and PDF.
